# Handoff: office space for lease pages (Suite 100, Suite 101, /2490/ hub)

Written from what is in the repo (git history, tools/build_site.py, site/). The session that built these pages is not
one of the cloud sessions, and its chat notes could not be read. Anything not listed here (reasons, raw originals) lives only there.

## Pages (all generated by tools/build_site.py, published like every other page)
| URL | Purpose |
|---|---|
| /suite-101/ | 956 sq ft lower-level office/medical suite at 2490 Walton Blvd. The QR code on the Suite 101 road sign points here. KEEP THIS ADDRESS STABLE (printed sign). |
| /suite-100/ | 528 sq ft lower-level office/medical suite at 2490 Walton Blvd. |
| /2490/ | Hub listing all available office space at 2490 Walton Blvd. Linked from the Commercial page ("Now leasing"). |
| /office-space-for-lease/ and /2490lease/ | Older hub addresses. Small redirect pages written by build_site.py (loop near line 363) so shared links keep working. |

Sitemap entries for all three live pages are in the PAGES list in build_site.py (around line 255).

## Code
- tools/build_site.py: Suite 101 block (`s101_fig`, `s101_vid`, `s101_body`, `page("suite-101/", ...)`), Suite 100 block, hub `page("2490/", ...)`, redirect loop.
- tools/audit.py: updated to know about these pages.
- Shared listing styles (.lst-top, .lst-facts, etc.) are in site/styles.css and also used by /properties/grand-blanc-land/.

## Media (web-sized versions only are in the repo)
- site/assets/images/suite-100-*.jpg (floor plan + 3 interiors)
- site/assets/images/suite-101-*.jpg (building, building-wide, floor plan, photos 1-8, two video posters)
- site/assets/video/suite-101-walkthrough-1.mp4 (about 0.9 MB) and suite-101-walkthrough-2.mp4 (about 2.9 MB)
- The ORIGINAL full-size photos and raw video clips are NOT in the repo. If they were uploaded only to the session that built
  the pages, they exist only there or on the owner's computer. Keep copies before deleting any session.

## Decisions visible in the commit history (2026-10-06)
- Rent and move-in costs removed from the office lease pages; visitors "call for pricing" (commit fa79ef0).
- Suite 101 photos replaced with the October 2026 set; photo 8 orientation fixed; "lower level" wording added (matches Suite 100).
- Two walkthrough videos: second one is the full 28 second walkthrough; videos stacked at full content-column width, no letterbox bars;
  Centrale logo overlay at upper left; rotation fix on video 2; audio removed.
- Suite 100 and hub content column widened to match Suite 101.
- Hub address moved: /office-space-for-lease/ -> /2490lease/ -> /2490/, with redirects at each step.

## Publishing rules that matter
- One publish routine for all sessions: pull latest, build, audit, regenerate the deploy repo from the latest centrale-realty-site main, push, verify live.
- The upload script skips files whose size is unchanged, so a change that only reorders text can look "deployed" but not appear. Re-run the
  GitHub Action "Deploy to GoDaddy (FTPS)" with force=true in that case.
- Do not let two sessions push to centrale-realty-site at once.
